newsitem.title: UK: Prudential results show steady growth.
newsitem.headline: Prudential results show steady growth.

text.p: Prudential Corp, Britain's largest life insurance group, reported a rise in operating profits on Wednesday and said the 1996 performance demonstrated the strength of the group's core business.
Operating profits for the year rose over eight percent to 873 million pounds ($1.4 billion) with profits from continuing operations of 691 million pounds.
The dividend was raised by 10 percent to 17.3 pence per share.
The year was described as "very successful" by the Pru's chief executive Sir Peter Davis.

He said that with the disposal of Mercantile & General and launch of Prudential Banking, considerable progress had been made in focusing the group on those markets where the Pru had the expertise and the critical mass to generate real value for shareholders.

Prudential UK operating profits from insurance business increased eight percent to 398 million pounds and operating profits for the UK's savings and investment business was 323 million pounds, an increase of six percent.
He said the current bid for mutually owned Scottish Amicable, if successful, would enhance the group's core UK operations.
